title: Internal Sales / New Business Executive
description:
Internal Sales / New Business Executive

Location: Bradford, West Yorkshire

Salary: 30,000 - 35,000 basic + Bonus + Benefits

Streamline Search is working with an established and highly regarded large-format print and visual communications business that is looking to appoint an ambitious Internal Sales / New Business Executive.

Our client has built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality print and visual communication solutions to a broad range of commercial customers across the UK.

The business offers an end-to-end service, supporting customers from initial concept and technical consultation through to production, finishing and installation.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven sales professional who enjoys prospecting, opening doors and developing new customer relationships.

The role will initially be predominantly office-based, focused on generating and qualifying new business opportunities through proactive outbound activity.

There is genuine scope for the successful candidate to develop into a more senior Business Development position over time, taking greater ownership of customer meetings, account development and the full sales cycle.

Package
- 30,000 - 35,000 basic salary
- Uncapped / performance-related bonus structure
- Permanent position
- Monday to Friday office-based role
- Opportunity to join an established and respected business
- Excellent product and production capabilities
- Strong market reputation
- Genuine progression into a Business Development role
- Support from experienced senior commercial staff on meetings and larger opportunities

The Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities through proactive outbound sales activity.

This is a genuine new-business role and would suit someone who enjoys picking up the phone, speaking with decision-makers, qualifying opportunities and building a strong pipeline.

Initially, the focus will be on prospecting, lead generation and developing relationships from first contact. For larger opportunities, you will work closely with senior commercial colleagues who can support with client meetings, technical discussions, proposals and closing.

As you develop your knowledge and customer base, there will be scope to take greater ownership of the complete sales cycle and progress into a Business Development Manager position.

Key Responsibilities
- Making proactive outbound calls to prospective customers
- Identifying and targeting businesses with potential large-format print and visual communication requirements
- Building relationships with key decision-makers
- Generating and qualifying new business opportunities
- Developing opportunities through telephone, email and LinkedIn outreach
- Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective customers
- Booking customer meetings for yourself and senior commercial colleagues
- Following up quotations, proposals and live opportunities
- Working closely with senior management to progress and close larger opportunities
- Approaching marketing teams, agencies, retailers, contractors, event businesses and other relevant organisations
- Understanding customer requirements and introducing suitable solutions
- Keeping CRM and pipeline information accurate and up to date
- Re-engaging previous customers and dormant accounts
- Identifying opportunities across new sectors and markets
- Converting prospects into profitable, long-term customers
- Achieving agreed activity, new-business and revenue targets

The Candidate

We are looking for an ambitious, confident and commercially driven sales professional who genuinely enjoys new-business development.

You do not necessarily need to have worked within large-format print previously, although experience within print, manufacturing, signage, packaging, marketing services or another B2 B environment would be advantageous.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous B2 B sales, internal sales, telesales or business development experience
- A genuine appetite for winning new business
- Confidence making outbound calls and approaching new organisations
- Strong communication skills and a natural ability to build rapport
- A proactive and resilient approach to sales
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to discuss customer requirements
- Strong follow-up and organisational skills
- A target-driven mindset
- The ability to work independently while also taking guidance from senior colleagues
- A desire to develop into a more senior Business Development position

This role could suit an experienced Internal Sales Executive, New Business Executive, Sales Executive, Business Development Executive or an ambitious Account Manager looking to move into a more proactive new-business position.

Streamline Search is a technical recruitment agency based in Chichester, West Sussex, operating across the United Kingdom. We are acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this vacancy and, in accordance with GDPR, by applying to this post you are granting us consent to process your data and contact you in relation to this application.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a driven Internal Sales Executive to work for a dynamic and market-leading business within portable accommodation, modular buildings and associated solutions.

This is a varied internal sales and account management role supporting some of the organisation s largest national customers. You will work closely with Key Account Managers and Directors, helping to develop customer relationships, convert enquiries into sales and identify further opportunities within existing accounts.

The role would suit candidates with experience as an Internal Sales Executive, Account Manager, Account Executive, Telesales Executive, Sales Executive or Customer Service Advisor within a commercially focused environment.

- Proactively contact customers to develop relationships, identify new requirements and expand the sales pipeline.

title: Account Manager
description:
Account Manager

Location: Huddersfield

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full Time

Purpose of the Role:

The Account Manager is responsible for the overall success, performance and growth of a portfolio of parcel locker clients. Acting as the senior operational and commercial lead for assigned accounts, the Account Manager will ensure client satisfaction, delivery performance, contractual compliance, profitability and long-term relationship development.

Supported by an administration and helpdesk function, the Account Manager will coordinate internal resources to ensure seamless delivery of deployment and project activities across the client portfolio.

The role requires ownership of client performance from onboarding through to ongoing operational support, ensuring Brand Link consistently delivers against client expectations and strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management
- Act as the primary senior point of contact for assigned parcel locker clients.
- Build and maintain strong client relationships at operational and strategic levels.
- Conduct regular service review meetings and business update meetings.
- Manage client expectations and ensure agreed service levels are achieved.
- Identify opportunities to strengthen client partnerships and increase account value.
- Lead contract review discussions and support contract renewals and extensions.
- Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of client concerns.

Account Ownership & Performance
- Take full ownership of the operational and commercial performance of assigned accounts.
- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs).
- Ensure account profitability is maintained through effective resource planning and cost control.
- Produce performance reports and account dashboards for both clients and internal stakeholders.
- Identify risks, issues and trends that may impact service delivery.
- Develop and implement improvement plans where performance falls below expectations.

Operational Coordination
- Oversee all parcel locker related activities for assigned clients, including:
- Installations
- Reactive works
- Relocations
- Upgrades
- Electrical and civils works
- Site surveys
- Coordinate activities across:
- Operations
- Project Management
- Helpdesk
- Administration
- Warehouse
- Logistics
- Supply Chain
- Ensure client requirements are translated into achievable operational plans.

Helpdesk & Administration Leadership
- Provide direction and support to the helpdesk and administration teams supporting assigned accounts.
- Ensure client queries, service requests, incidents and escalations are managed effectively.
- Monitor response times and service performance.
- Maintain high standards of communication and customer service.
- Ensure all administrative records, trackers, reports, permits and account documentation remain accurate and up to date.

Commercial Management
- Support budgeting, forecasting and revenue planning activities.
- Monitor account profitability and identify opportunities for margin improvement.
- Review quotations and variations associated with account activities.
- Support invoicing activities and ensure commercial processes are completed accurately.
- Identify additional revenue opportunities through service enhancements and project opportunities.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
- Drive process improvements across client accounts.
- Support the implementation of new systems, procedures and technologies.
- Share best practice across the wider account management and operations teams.

Health, Safety & Compliance
- Promote and maintain a strong health and safety culture.
- Ensure all activities are delivered in accordance with company policies and statutory requirements.
- Support the review of RAMS, permits, and compliance documentation where required.
- Escalate any compliance concerns immediately.

Key Skills, Qualifications & Experience:

Essential
- Proven experience in Account Management, Operations Management or Client Services.
- Experience managing major customer accounts within logistics, facilities management, infrastructure, retail rollout, technology deployment, or parcel locker operations.
- Strong commercial awareness and financial understanding.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

Desirable
- Experience working within parcel locker, logistics, field service, retail deployment, or facilities management sectors.
- Knowledge of civils and electrical delivery environments.
- Experience managing helpdesk or customer support functions.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Principle Global, please do not hesititate to apply.
